questions.question: Differentiate between line cable and speaker cable? / Explain clipping distortion with a neat waveform diagram. How can it be
questions.solution_html:
• Line Cables- carry low-voltage, high-impedance signals. They are shielded to protect against
  • EMI/RFI interference- Speaker Cables- carry high-voltage, low-impedance signals. They are
  • unshielded and use thicker gauge wire to handle high current without significant power loss.

questions.question: Discuss the advantages and limitations of OFC in audio communication?
questions.solution_html:
• Advantages
  • - High bandwidth, low distortion
  • - Immune to electromagnetic interference
  • - Low signal loss, long-distance transmission
  • - Electrical isolation prevents ground loops
  • - Limitations
  • - Higher cost
  • - Fragile, prone to breakage
  • - Requires special transmitters/receivers
  • - Difficult to repair/splice.
questions.final_answer: - Difficult to repair/splice
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain highly directional microphones in detail.
questions.solution_html:
• Primarily refers to Shotgun Microphones- They use an interference tube to cancel
  • out sound arriving from the sides through destructive interference while
  • maintaining high sensitivity for sound directly in front. Essential for film sets and
  • field recording- also explain about Super and hyper cardioid.
questions.final_answer: field recording- also explain about Super and hyper cardioid

questions.question: Explain in detail the concept of loudspeaker baffles and enclosures.
questions.solution_html:
• Baffles: A board used to mount drivers, preventing the rear sound wave (which is 180 degrees
  • out of phase) from cancelling the front wave. Enclosures include Sealed (Acoustic
  • Suspension) for tight bass, and Ported (Bass Reflex), which uses a tuned vent to increase
  • low-frequency efficiency.
questions.final_answer: low-frequency efficiency
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
